verdict.rationale: Maritime documents that every API key carries scopes and tells users to hand each subsystem the narrowest key, so a leaked key can only do what its scope allows. It gives a concrete least-privilege example: a Computers-only key, created in Settings, is refused on every other Maritime endpoint. Keys are minted via `maritime keys create` for agent use. missing for 10: a documented catalog of available scopes beyond `computers`, evidence that scopes can be set from the CLI/API when minting agent keys, expiry or time-bounding of keys (docs say keys never expire), and independent or hands-on corroboration of scope enforcement.
